messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

John, your order Shop···· is paid but hasn't shipped yet. Your Magic M. 40T is still waiting for stock to reach our US warehouse, and your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA is on the same order.

Magic M. planned to ship all the units from the factory on November 12. I can't see that shipment at our warehouse yet. We'll email the tracking to (email hidden) as soon as your miner ships, so you don't need to check back here.

You can follow the stock on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is something about the wait worrying you?
